job: Group the parts of one object on a quiet surface.
purpose: A white surface with a 1px faint edge and no shadow at rest. Head, body and foot are optional parts; the foot sticks to the bottom when cards share a row. data-interactive makes the whole card a link or button. Cards never nest.
useWhen: One object (a key, a team, a plan, a provider) has a title, some facts and an action.
A catalogue shows many similar things in a grid: use fd-card-grid.
The whole card opens a page: add data-interactive and fd-card-arrow.

avoidWhen.when: A figure with a disclosure of detail, such as credits remaining.
A set of headline numbers in a row.
A single pricing option with a price and features.
Rows that are mostly text and one action.
A section inside a card needs structure.
avoidWhen.instead: Use a hairline, never a card inside a card.

states.name: interactive
states.how: data-interactive on a link or button card; the edge darkens on hover and the press scales to 99%

states.name: flush
states.how: data-flush removes padding for tables and lists that run edge to edge

states.name: selected
states.how: aria-current="true" (open beside a list) or aria-selected="true" on a data-interactive card: an accent wash and edge

variants.useWhen: A card that should sit back: no edge, a faint fill.
A card set into the page, such as a code or detail well.
The one card people should notice.
A single object that owns a column, like a plan or team summary.
A dense card in a tight grid.
The whole card is one link or button.
Content runs to the edge, as with a table or list.

parts.role: The footer; separated by a hairline.
A grid that keeps card feet aligned.
The corner arrow of an interactive card.
One live fact in the foot, such as free credits left.
A summary split into labelled cells.
A mono price range in the foot.
A muted count in the foot.

keyboard.does: Opens an interactive card that is a link.
Presses an interactive card that is a button.
